title: Static or motion, which approach gets more clicks for you? 💸
description: Static or motion, which approach gets more clicks for you? 💸
transcript: What makes a great video ad, but not a great static ad. video ads are always gonna have higher drop off rates than image ads. Image you just get it immediately, but lower percentage of people are gonna make it to the end of your video ad as opposed to the amount of people that basically consume entire image. So you compensate for that by making sure that you really sell people along one of those lines.
